description: D4 mode-matrix — preset P9 (cycle:spec-to-ship, window [4→9]) under M2 (checkpoint-gated). Runner auto-traverses specification through architecture, then halts at HUMAN_CHECKPOINT before build. Resumes only when injected decision token [HIMA_DECISION:approved] appears in turn 2. Models GOAL-3 §4c M2: 'auto through analysis+spec; HUMAN_CHECKPOINT before architecture/build; resume → stop'. P9 includes build: noBuildBeforeTurn=2 asserts build may not start before the decision token is injected.

turns.text: Activate cycle:spec-to-ship:gate. Run specification through architecture automatically. Then halt at HUMAN_CHECKPOINT — do not proceed to build or quality-release until a decision token is injected.
[HIMA_DECISION:approved] Continue to build and quality-release. Implement, test, and ship. Produce a deployed, production-ready build passing the reliability tier gate.

d4.contract: Auto through stages 4–6 (specification→architecture); halt at HUMAN_CHECKPOINT before build; resume on injected decision token; then complete build+quality-release and stop
d4.ref: GOAL-3.md §4c M2 row; GOAL-3.md §5 D4 'M2 halts at HUMAN_CHECKPOINT post-spec, resumes on injected decision'; mode-axis.md §1 M2 'paused at architecture/build boundary'; noBuildBeforeTurn=2 enforces no build before turn 2
